findings:
🟠 [gate-bare-fail-test-not-last] MUST-FIX `finalizes()` accepts a bare `[ "$FAIL" -eq 0 ]` on ANY non-comment line (`grep -qE` over the whole stripped file), but that shape only propagates a nonzero exit when it is the last command executed; a suite with that line followed by any other command (an `echo` summary, a cleanup `rm`, a `trap`) exits 0 on failure yet passes the gate. The self-check only exercises a one-line file so it cannot catch this. Smallest fix: for the bare (no `|| exit 1`) form, match only the last non-blank non-comment line, e.g. `grep -avE '^[[:space:]]*(#|$)' "$1" | tail -n1 | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*\[ "\$\{?FAIL\}?" -eq 0 \][[:space:]]*$'`, and add a negative self-check file where `[ "$FAIL" -eq 0 ]` is followed by `echo done`.
🟠 [gate-exitcode-anywhere] MUST-FIX The `process\.exitCode[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*1` rule matches anywhere in the file, including node fixture/stub scripts written via heredoc to simulate a failing tool; such a suite would be counted as finalizing even though its own assertions never exit nonzero. Smallest fix: restrict the match to lines inside the suite's assertion/summary driver (e.g. require the suite's last non-comment command to be the `node` invocation, or require the `exitCode = 1` line to be within the same heredoc as a `passed.*failed` summary), or drop this rule and keep the affected suites allowlisted with an "own harness, exits nonzero at <line>" comment per spec.
🔵 [allowlist-comment-count] CUT/FOLLOW-UP Header comment says "The 13 suites … left this list" but 18 → 7 entries is 11 removed; also the spec asked to flag `mission-terminal-rollover` (ran `0 passed, 0 failed`) and it is silently removed with no note. Cosmetic/doc only; correct the count and add a one-line note when fixing the above.
